Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. The user liked THIS version's shield, spear and full-body gold aura but rejected the helmet and armor design. Redesign ONLY THE HELMET AND BODY ARMOR. Treat the weapon, shield, gold energy, pose, proportions, framing and background as locked.

New art direction: a formidable dark royal guardian in expertly forged blackened steel and silver. Strong, deliberate armored forms and iconic craftsmanship, with a distinct visual change from the current swept horn / flame-shaped helmet and many pointed rib plates.

HELMET — entirely different silhouette:
Remove the long curving horns, tall crown prongs and flame-like head spikes. Create a close-fitting, commanding angular closed greathelm, sculpted to the head with a short, restrained integrated central crest. A strong silver brow spans a deep narrow horizontal visor slit with restrained warm gold light. Clean faceted cheek plates taper into a dignified, solid lower face guard; dark recessed planes and polished silver structural edges give depth. Subtle fine engraving and small black-and-gold inset details at the temples. The helmet should be instantly recognizable and premium, neither a plain bucket nor a skull, dragon head, insect face, beak, oversized crown or generic horned demon. No exposed human face. Preserve the original head position, direction and natural head-to-body scale.

ARMOR — redesign coherently to match the new helmet:
Use a powerful, beautifully shaped black-steel cuirass with a broad central breastplate and an elegant raised silver central keel. Bold polished silver framing, precise bevels and selectively engraved recessed panels. A small sophisticated geometric gold inlay is integrated into the chest, not a huge light or jewel. Upper chest and collar look substantial. Pauldrons are weighty angular layered plates with clear structure and restrained raised ridges, rather than sweeping leaf spikes. Articulated waist, arms and leg plates have clean panel spacing and fine craftsmanship. A few larger calm dark metal planes should contrast with the sharp silver edges and fine gold accents. The armor is lavish SSS quality through silhouette, construction and material richness, not clutter or engraving on every square centimeter. Preserve the athletic adult body, existing limbs, stance and limb placement.

STRICTLY PRESERVE:
The accepted huge black/silver shield, including its exact outline, scale, shape, engraving, angle and position. The accepted diagonal spear, its long continuous rigid straight shaft, both end details, metal colors, grip and exact position. The full-body flowing ivory-gold aura around shoulders, torso, hips and legs, its intensity and warm luminous fragments. The cathedral, lighting, fog at the feet, composition and painterly fantasy rendering. Do not repaint or redesign these accepted elements. Keep the whole body opaque and clearly defined underneath the light. No new cape, wings, extra weapons or objects; no extra limbs. No text, letters, rank badge, frame, logo or watermark.
